summary: D-FUTURE-07 AI Smart Import Clienti v1 — full end-to-end testing PASSED. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass on /app/backend/tests/test_clients_ai_import.py (47.6s, real Gemini calls). Covers: messy CSV with arbitrary columns (source_format=csv, total_rows>=2, confidence_buckets present, names extracted), vCard parsing (source_format=vcf, 2 contacts), free-form txt (source_format=txt, Marco/Sara extracted), 400 empty_file, 413 oversize (>5MB), GET draft persistence, GET /draft/does-not-exist → 404, PATCH row updates phone/client_type with normalization, PATCH {drop:true} marks _drop, commit with min_confidence=0 inserts source='ai_import', double commit → 409, min_confidence=99 returns min_confidence_used=99, unauth 401/403, route-ordering regression /clients/import/ai NOT shadowed by /clients/{cid}. Regression: test_clients_smart.py 10/10 + test_client_csv_import.py 4/4 still green. Frontend /it/app/clients/import: both tabs visible ('Import AI' active default with novità badge, 'Template CSV'), AI dropzone visible with editorial-sober styling. Uploaded messy CSV (3 cols arbitrary: 'nome cliente;telefono;mail;cerca;budget max;città') → 'ai-loading' shown → 'ai-preview' rendered with 2 rows within ~7s. Slider set to 0 updates counter. Row 1 dropped → ai-row-undrop-1 appears. Row 0 expanded successfully. GDPR checked. Commit button text='⚡ Importa 1 clienti' (correctly reflects min-conf + dropped row). Click commit → ai-import-done screen appears. Legacy 'Template CSV' tab still renders Step 1/Step 2 layout (Scarica template, Trascina file CSV). Test client (source=ai_import) cleaned up via DELETE.

issues: Page H1 title still reads 'Importa clienti da CSV' even though page now supports CSV + AI + vCard + txt + xlsx. Consider renaming to 'Importa clienti' (generic) since CSV is only one of 4 supported formats — minor copy/i18n issue, not blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Rename i18n key client_import.title from 'Importa clienti da CSV' → 'Importa clienti' to match the new dual-mode page (CSV is one of 4 supported formats now).
critical_code_review_comments: clients_ai_import.py — clean module-level separation: format detection (extension + content sniff) → parser per format (csv reader/openpyxl/vobject/plaintext) → Gemini mapper with structured JSON schema → in-memory draft store with TTL → commit phase that inserts via standard /clients pipeline. ~5-15s LLM latency verified (no mocks).

Route mounting order verified in routes.py: clients_ai_import_router mounted BEFORE clients_router. Test test_route_not_treated_as_id explicitly checks /clients/import/ai/draft/{id} is not intercepted by /clients/{cid} regex. Robust.
Phone normalization in PATCH: '+39 999 888 7777' → '+399998887777' (whitespace stripped). Good.
Commit idempotency via 409 conflict on second call — prevents double-insert race. Excellent.

ClientImportPage.jsx (559 lines) — approaching the 700-line soft limit but still acceptable since two distinct flows (AI + CSV) coexist with their own state machines. Could be split into ClientImportAI.jsx + ClientImportCSV.jsx in a future refactor for maintainability.

All required data-testids present: import-tabs, tab-ai, tab-csv, ai-dropzone, ai-file-input, ai-loading, ai-preview, ai-rows-list, ai-row-{idx}, ai-row-expand-{idx}, ai-row-drop-{idx}, ai-row-undrop-{idx}, ai-min-conf-slider, ai-gdpr-checkbox, ai-commit-btn, ai-import-done, ai-import-error.
Confidence badges use editorial-sober minimal palette: emerald-50/amber-50/red-50 backgrounds with darker text — matches stone palette spec. No vivid red/orange/green fills.
tab-ai novità highlight uses text-emerald-700 (only when not active) — acceptable accent, not violating palette.
Frontend handles upload errors via formatApiErrorDetail and renders ai-import-error testid — good error UX.
GDPR consent checkbox is opt-in (unchecked by default) — correct GDPR-by-default behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (full dual-tab flow + commit + legacy tab regression)
